create_sideeffectpenalty: create a SideEffectPenalty instance with a baseline and deviation measure to calculate impact penalties
calculate_reachability_deviation: calculate the reachability deviation between current and baseline states using the Reachability class
build_stepwise_baseline: build a StepwiseBaseline that tracks the state one no-op after the previous state with optional rollouts
update_attainable_utility: update attainable utility estimates for state transitions using the AttainableUtility deviation measure
run_uvfa_reachability: run UVFA-based reachability estimation using neural networks to approximate relative reachability between states
